text:
avery: paging oncall — we9re seeing sustained throughput degradation for embeddings in eu-central-1 since ~02:10 UTC. top-line: tokens/sec down ~40%, p99 latency up, small rise in 5xx (~0.5%).

lucas: thanks. any recent deploys or config changes in that region?

avery: yes, we rolled out connection-pool-tuner v1.4 at 02:00 on the worker pool. cpu/gpu utilization looks fine, but queue depth on the frontend proxies is climbing.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: service=inference-embed, region=eu-central-1, severity=prod-degraded, metric=throughput, triggered=2026-03-16T02:11:07Z

riley: assigning to lucas + avery. lucas 1: can you start the runbook check for "throughput-drop"? tag customer-impact and routing.

lucas: running checks: `kubectl top nodes`, `kubectl get hpa -n inference`, `rcli metrics query --m throughput --region eu-central-1 --last 60m`. Seeing HPA at max, but cluster autoscaler is in cooldown (recent scale event at 01:50). autoscaler shows pending nodes but they9re stuck in provisioning.

avery: provisioning delays could explain it. any events from cloud-provisioner?

lucas: yes: `ec2-provisioner` reported `ENI quota` warnings for eu-central-1 account; new nodes cannot attach until quota increased.

ops-bot: ALERT: cloud quota reached for account prod-eu (ENI limit). Suggested actions: request quota increase or fallback routing.

riley: two immediate mitigations: 1) fallback routing for 25% traffic to us-west-2 low-latency pool, 2) reduce per-worker concurrency to alleviate queue growth. will implement both.

avery: implementing reduced concurrency via routing-policy patch: `rcli route update --region eu-central-1 --concurrency 4 --policy temp-throughput-fix`

ops-bot: ROUTE_UPDATE: eu-central-1 concurrency set to 4 by avery at 2026-03-16T02:18:45Z

lucas: initiating partial cross-region reroute: `rcli route shift --from eu-central-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 25 --policy emergency-fallback`

ops-bot: ROUTE_SHIFT: 25% traffic from eu-central-1 -> us-west-2 initiated by lucas at 2026-03-16T02:19:22Z

avery: restarting a few proxy pods to clear backlog: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/proxy -n inference --selector=zone=eu-central-1`

(5m later)

lucas: quick telemetry: throughput improved on canary traffic by ~18%, overall cluster throughput +10%. queue depth decreasing but still above normal. provisioning still pending (quota).

emily: drafting status page note and customer advisory. rough copy below, please review. want to be clear and actionable for customers.

```
Status: Partial degradation 0eu-central-1
Impact: Reduced throughput for embedding requests in eu-central-1; some customers may see higher latencies or occasional 5xx errors.
What we9re doing: Applying temporary routing and concurrency changes to reduce queuing and rerouting a subset of traffic to alternate regions while we work with cloud provider to restore capacity.
ETA: 60-120 minutes for full recovery depending on quota/infra provisioning.
Contact: support@redwood.ai for targeted updates and tenant-specific impact.
```

riley: suggestion: tighten ETA to 45-90 min after we confirm node provisioning or if quota increase request accepted.

emily: updated ETA per riley. also adding targeted tenant note template for those seeing significant impact.

avery: found one more signal: a small set of tenants are issuing bulk embed batches (500+ items) concurrently which is exacerbating queue pressure. flagged those tenant IDs in the incident board.

lucas: temporary throttle rule: apply a per-tenant batch limit for eu-central-1 to protect cluster while we restore nodes. command: `rcli tenant update --id T-3421 --max-batch 100 --region eu-central-1 --reason "incident protection"`

ops-bot: TENANT_RATE_LIMIT: T-3421 max_batch set to 100 by lucas at 2026-03-16T02:34:10Z

riley: next steps checklist for oncall handoff:
```
- Confirm ENI quota request status with cloud ops (ticket #CLOUD-7891)
- Monitor canary throughput and p99 latency every 10m
- Keep route shift until >30m stable and queue depth < threshold
- If provisioning succeeds, scale pool +3 and revert routing policy
- Communicate to affected tenants (account team) with mitigation suggestions
```

emily: targeted customer message draft: 
```
Hi <tenant>,
We're seeing temporary throughput degradation in eu-central-1 which may affect large batch embedding jobs. We've applied temporary throttles and routed some traffic to alternate regions. If you have critical workloads, consider reducing concurrent batch size or routing to dedicated capacity. We're working to restore capacity and will update you within 60 minutes.  Redwood Inference Support
```

lucas: cloud ops replied: quota request submitted to cloud provider, ETA 45-90 minutes. ticket updated.

avery: monitoring update 20m in: canary traffic steady, overall throughput at ~85% of baseline. p99 trending down. still holding route shift and per-tenant limits.

(40m later)

lucas: cloud provider approved ENI increase; new nodes are provisioning. scaling planned: `infractl scale pool inference-eu-central 3` once nodes ready.

ops-bot: CLOUD_QUOTA_UPDATE: ENI quota increased for prod-eu by cloud-provider at 2026-03-16T03:12:01Z

avery: scaling pool now that ENIs are available. `infractl scale pool inference-eu-central 3`

ops-bot: SCALE: pool inference-eu-central increased by 3 nodes by avery at 2026-03-16T03:16:07Z

lucas: after scale, throughput back to ~98% baseline, p99 normalized. reverting routing policy and tenant limits gradually.

avery: removing route shift: `rcli route shift --from eu-central-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 25 --policy emergency-fallback --revert`

ops-bot: ROUTE_SHIFT_REVERT: 25% traffic shifted back to eu-central-1 by lucas at 2026-03-16T03:25:33Z

emily: status page update suggestion for "resolved" section and messaging to affected tenants prepared.

riley: handoff note for night oncall: 
```
- Incident: eu-central-1 throughput drop due to ENI quota exhaustion blocking node provisioning
- Actions taken: reduced concurrency per worker, cross-region reroute (25%), applied tenant batch limits, requested ENI quota increase, scaled pool +3 when quota available
- Current state: throughput ~98% baseline, p99 normalized, routing and limits reverted
- Post-incident actions: RCA to include: quota alerting earlier, automated fallback for ENI exhaustion, HPA+ASG coupling review, better notifications to account teams for large-batch tenants
- Owner: lucas -> next oncall
```

avery: agreed. I'll file the postmortem and tag cloud-ops and account teams. closing the active paging channel; will post final RCA timeline tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

emily: final note to customers being sent now. thanks team.

(incident will be added to postmortems channel when RCA is complete)
